notes.fighting.title: The fighting game's title, on its menu.
notes.fighting.menu.versus: A mode: two players against each other (or player 1 alone while player 2 hasn't joined).
notes.fighting.menu.arcade: A mode: you against the CPU, fighter after fighter.
notes.fighting.menu.training: A mode: practice on a dummy, with the hit boxes and frame data shown.
notes.fighting.menu.rematch: After a match: fight it again.
notes.fighting.menu.select: After a match: back to the character select screen.
notes.fighting.menu.continue: After losing an arcade fight: fight again (a menu entry).
notes.fighting.menu.title: Back to the title screen (a menu entry).
notes.fighting.mode.training: The boxes: the hit boxes drawn over the fighters; frame data: each move's timing.
notes.fighting.join: 2 is the key on a keyboard, START the button on a gamepad: keep them as they are.
notes.fighting.keys: {lp} {hp} {lk} {hk}: the four buttons (light punch, heavy punch, light kick, heavy kick), e.g. U I J K on a keyboard.
notes.fighting.keys.player: As fighting.keys, for one of two players: {player} is 1 or 2 (P1: player 1).
notes.fighting.keys.help: {keys} is the line fighting.keys. ARROWS: the arrow keys. Hints separated by three spaces.
notes.fighting.notation: 236: the number pad's directions (2 down, 3 down-forward, 6 forward), the way fighting games write a motion; keep the numbers.
notes.fighting.about.ryo: Under the fighter's portrait on the select screen: what kind of fighter he is.
notes.fighting.about.gorm: Under the fighter's portrait: a wrestler who throws.
notes.fighting.about.vex: Under the fighter's portrait: she is fast and can teleport.
notes.fighting.shadow: The arcade's last foe: a dark copy of your own fighter. {name} is the fighter's name.
notes.fighting.stage: Arcade: which fight of the ladder this is, e.g. STAGE 1 OF 3.
notes.fighting.dummy: Training: what the dummy does ({dummy}: STAND, CROUCH, JUMP or GUARD); TAB is the key, BACK the gamepad button that changes it.
notes.fighting.continue: You lost an arcade fight: try again?
notes.action.lp: Light punch: the button's name on the controls screen (LP on a touch button).
notes.action.hp: Heavy punch: the button's name on the controls screen (HP on a touch button).
notes.action.lk: Light kick: the button's name on the controls screen (LK on a touch button).
notes.action.hk: Heavy kick: the button's name on the controls screen (HK on a touch button).
notes.action.dummy: Training: the key that changes what the dummy does, on the controls screen.

brief: The fighting game: one on one in the spirit of Street Fighter II, best of three rounds on a temple courtyard, with three fighters: RYO (a man, an all-rounder), GORM (a man, a grappler) and VEX (a woman, fast). Its menus and calls are arcade-style, short and in capitals. LP, HP, LK and HK are light punch, heavy punch, light kick and heavy kick; motions are written in number-pad notation (236), which stays as numbers.
